description: Building State Voluntary Organizations Active in Disaster (VOAD) Capacities to Protect Children in Emergencies: An Evaluation Research Project is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Lori Peek, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). Between 2018 and 2020, the Natural Hazards Center at the University of Colorado Boulder conducted an evaluation entitled: Building State Voluntary Organizations Active in Disaster (VOADs) Capacities to Protect Children in Emergencies. This project was designed to assess the capacity of state-level VOADs to address children’s needs before, during, and after disasters. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Children, Disasters, Voluntary Organizations Active in Disaster (VOADs), Evaluation Research, Participatory Asset Mapping, Survey Research. Published 2024-02-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
